function.name: think_tool
function.arguments: {"reflection":"Data check confirms regular 300 Hz sampling, no missing values, five zero widths, monotonic timestamps. Coarse 1-s bins show width rises sharply early (~2.1 at 0s bin to ~10.7 by 2s), then remains broadly elevated (~11-13) while shear rises early and then stays in a narrow band. The all-sample width/shear correlation (~0.55) is confounded by common time trend and must not be treated as mechanism. STE export becomes identically zero for final bins, suggesting unavailable/invalid uncertainty there; avoid using it as inferential uncertainty. Hypothesis set should explain early joint evolution and later dissociation, and offer discriminating interventions/measurements conditionally."}
